Role: Leader
Power Source: Martial
Key Abilities: Strength, Intelligence

CLASS TRAITS

Role: Leader. You rally allies with shouts and commands.

Power Source: Martial. You use military training and tactics.

Key Abilities: Strength, Intelligence

Armor Proficiencies: Cloth, leather, hide, chainmail, scale; light shields, heavy shields.

Weapon Proficiencies: Simple melee, military melee, simple ranged, military ranged

Bonuses to Defenses: +1 Fortitude, +1 Reflex, +1 Will

Hit Points at 1st Level: 12+ Constitution score

Hit Points per Level Gained: 5

Healing Surges per Day: 7+ Constitution modifier

Trained Skills: From the class skills list below, choose four trained skills at 1st level.

Class Skills: Athletics, Diplomacy, Endurance, Heal, History, Intimidate

Build Options: Bravura Warlord, Inspiring Warlord, Tactical Warlord, Resourceful Warlord, Skirmishing Warlord

Bravura Warlord

Bravura warlords lead from the front with daring attacks.

Tactical Warlord

Tactical warlords coordinate allies with precise commands.
